nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Implements UnifiedEventHandler, the central dispatcher that receives all streaming LLM and tool-execution events for a turn and fans them out to the UI event store, hooks, snapshots and the Wingman status bar.

nodes.name: tool_result_is_error
nodes.summary: Determines whether a tool's raw result payload represents an error outcome, used to decide event severity and downstream handling.

nodes.name: should_push_assistant_event
nodes.summary: Decides whether a final assistant-message event still needs to be pushed given what was already streamed, avoiding duplicate UI events.

nodes.name: is_current_turn_generation
nodes.summary: Checks whether the handler's active turn generation still matches the session's current generation, guarding against stale events from a superseded turn.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a UnifiedEventHandler from an EventHandlerConfig, initializing its streaming buffer and per-turn tracking state.

nodes.name: flush_streaming
nodes.summary: Flushes any buffered streaming message/thinking content for a session into a finalized event, called at end-of-turn or on interruption.

nodes.name: tool_call_count
nodes.summary: Returns how many tool calls the handler has observed during the current turn.

nodes.name: todo_was_called
nodes.summary: Reports whether the todo-list tool was invoked during the current turn.

nodes.name: agent_was_called
nodes.summary: Reports whether a sub-agent/orchestration tool was invoked during the current turn.

nodes.name: push_to_store
nodes.summary: Appends a UI event to the session's event store so the frontend can pick it up.

nodes.name: broadcast_tool_call_delta
nodes.summary: Broadcasts an incremental streamed chunk of a tool call's arguments to the UI as it accumulates.

nodes.name: finalize_streaming_in_store
nodes.summary: Commits the currently-buffered streaming content into the session's persistent event store as a completed message.

nodes.name: on_message_delta
nodes.summary: Handles a streamed assistant-message text delta, appending it to the streaming buffer and broadcasting the update.

nodes.name: on_thinking_delta
nodes.summary: Handles a streamed extended-thinking delta, buffering and broadcasting it separately from the visible message.

nodes.name: on_tool_call_delta
nodes.summary: Handles an incremental tool-call streaming event, accumulating partial arguments and emitting live preview updates.

nodes.name: on_context_usage
nodes.summary: Handles a context-usage telemetry event from the provider, updating the handler's last-known token accounting.

nodes.name: on_tool_call
nodes.summary: Handles a fully-formed tool call event, building and pushing the corresponding UI event and tracking the invocation.

nodes.name: on_file_change
nodes.summary: Handles notification that a tool modified files on disk, used to trigger UI refresh/snapshot updates for the affected paths.

nodes.name: on_tool_result
nodes.summary: Handles a tool's completed result, building and pushing the corresponding result event to the UI.

nodes.name: on_tool_result_with_metadata
nodes.summary: Handles a tool result that carries extra UI metadata such as diff/preview data, attaching it to the emitted event.

nodes.name: on_assistant_iteration_complete
nodes.summary: Handles completion of one LLM iteration within a turn, finalizing streamed content and recording which model produced it.

nodes.name: on_tool_execute_start
nodes.summary: Handles the moment a tool begins executing, used for hook dispatch and live status updates before the tool runs.

nodes.name: before_tool_execute
nodes.summary: Runs pre-execution checks/hooks for a tool call before it is allowed to proceed.

nodes.name: on_turn_stop_check
nodes.summary: Handles a mid-turn stop-check event, determining whether the turn should be interrupted based on hook/cancellation state.

nodes.name: on_steering_consumed
nodes.summary: Handles acknowledgment that a user steering/injection message was consumed by the running turn.

nodes.name: after_tool_execute
nodes.summary: Handles tool-execution completion bookkeeping such as timing and error capture, after a tool call returns.

nodes.name: post_tool_hook
nodes.summary: Dispatches the post-tool-execution hook chain (LSP diagnostics, org lifecycle hooks) after a tool call completes.

nodes.name: on_stream_retry
nodes.summary: Handles a provider stream retry attempt, broadcasting retry progress to the UI.

nodes.name: on_stream_error_exhausted
nodes.summary: Handles the case where all stream retry attempts have been exhausted, broadcasting a terminal error to the UI.

nodes.name: EventHandlerConfig
nodes.summary: Bundles the dependencies a UnifiedEventHandler needs: workspace path, LSP manager, app handle, hook executor, turn id, cancellation flag and org lifecycle context.

nodes.name: AgentOrgTaskLifecycleContext
nodes.summary: Carries the org run id and member id needed to correlate turn events with an agent-org task's lifecycle.

nodes.name: UnifiedEventHandler
nodes.summary: Central dispatcher that receives all streaming LLM and tool-execution events for a turn and fans them out to the UI event store, hooks, snapshots and the Wingman status bar.

nodes.name: snapshots.rs
nodes.summary: Captures a workspace file snapshot/diff around a file-modifying tool call so the UI can show a before/after comparison.

nodes.name: take_snapshot
nodes.summary: Captures a workspace file snapshot/diff around a file-modifying tool call so the UI can show a before/after comparison.

nodes.name: wingman_tee.rs
nodes.summary: Tees tool call and tool result events to the Wingman floating status bar so it can reflect live tool activity.

nodes.name: tee_tool_call
nodes.summary: Forwards a tool-call event to the Wingman floating status bar so it can reflect live tool activity.

nodes.name: tee_tool_result
nodes.summary: Forwards a tool-result event to the Wingman status bar, updating its displayed status once a tool finishes.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel that re-exports the turn submodules (entry, event handling, processing, streaming, post-turn) and hosts a couple of debug/benchmark helper functions.

nodes.name: turn_max_iterations_from_session_model
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective maximum LLM iteration count for a turn, applying a session/model-specific override or falling back to a default.

nodes.name: debug_prefetch_zero_wait_probe
nodes.summary: Debug-only probe that measures prefetch task timing under a configurable artificial delay.

nodes.name: debug_prompt_cache_benchmark
nodes.summary: Debug-only benchmark that exercises the prompt cache to measure hit/miss behavior for a session.

nodes.name: post_turn.rs
nodes.summary: Spawns background post-turn work — session memory extraction, the extract-memories pipeline, and auto-dream reflection — once a turn has completed.

nodes.name: fresh_fork_provider
nodes.summary: Builds a fresh forked-session provider handle from a ForkProviderSpec, used to run post-turn background work in an isolated context.

nodes.name: spawn_session_memory_extraction
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task that extracts durable memories from a finished turn's messages and persists them to the session's memory store.

nodes.name: spawn_extract_memories
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task that runs the extract-memories pipeline against a turn's transcript using a forked provider.

nodes.name: run_extract_memories_task
nodes.summary: Runs the actual memory-extraction work for a forked session, invoked by the spawned extract-memories task.

nodes.name: spawn_auto_dream
nodes.summary: Spawns a background auto-dream task that reflects on a completed turn's transcript to synthesize learnings.

nodes.name: ForkProviderSpec
nodes.summary: Specifies the model, account, reliability tier, harness type and workspace to use when forking a provider for background post-turn work.

nodes.name: SessionMemoryExtractionInput
nodes.summary: Bundles the session id, messages, token/tool-call counts and memory-extraction state/config needed to spawn a memory extraction task.

nodes.name: ExtractMemoriesInput
nodes.summary: Bundles the session, workspace path, messages, final text and extraction state needed to run the extract-memories pipeline.

nodes.name: AutoDreamInput
nodes.summary: Bundles the session, workspace path, messages and auto-dream state needed to spawn the auto-dream reflection task.

nodes.name: compaction.rs
nodes.summary: Implements reactive and pre-turn context compaction: LLM-based summarization of message history when the token budget is exceeded or about to be.

nodes.name: adjust_sm_state_for_compactable_tail
nodes.summary: Adjusts the session-memory compaction state to account for a prefix of messages that were compacted away, keeping tail offsets consistent.

nodes.name: reactive_llm_compact_with_rescue
nodes.summary: Runs an LLM-based compaction pass over the tail of a session's history within a token budget, with a rescue fallback if compaction itself fails.

nodes.name: run_reactive_compaction
nodes.summary: Triggers compaction reactively after a provider rejects a request for exceeding context limits, shrinking the history so the turn can be retried.

nodes.name: run_pre_turn_compaction
nodes.summary: Proactively compacts a session's message history before starting a turn when estimated token usage is approaching budget.

nodes.name: CompactionPhaseOutcome
nodes.summary: Represents the outcome of a compaction phase: either the turn continues normally or execution is redirected onto a freshly forked session.

nodes.name: execute.rs
nodes.summary: Runs a turn to completion, automatically retrying with reactive context compaction if the provider reports the context window was exceeded.

nodes.name: execute_turn_with_reactive_retry
nodes.summary: Runs a turn to completion, automatically retrying with reactive compaction if the provider reports the context window was exceeded.

nodes.name: execute_with_reactive_compact
nodes.summary: Performs the actual retry attempt after a context-overflow error, first compacting the history then re-invoking the turn executor with the reduced messages.
